_about: Henry George (1839-1897), American economist of the single tax: Progress and Poverty, clean Gutenberg text (PG 55308) from the Memorial Edition of his Writings (New York: Doubleday, 1898); and The Complete Works of Henry George, 10 vols. (New York: Doubleday, Page, 1904), taken whole, raw IA OCR, clean 0.88-0.95. Vol. I of the Complete Works is Progress and Poverty again: the overlap is kept because the Gutenberg text is proofread. Vols. IX-X are the Life by his son Henry George Jr. (1862-1916). Vol. III's title page reads The Land Question; the shorter pieces bound with it are not itemised here. US public domain. No uids minted.
